In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What are the properties of the realizable MMSE LE?
the properties and connections of the realizable MMSE equalizers for single-user channels.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MMSE equalizer is not a unique solution to the equalization problem.
the MMSE LE and DFE are not only related but also connected, and that this connection is not only of theoretical but also of practical importance.
the MMSE equalizer for the single-input multiple-output channel is a realizable DFE with an LE as a prefilter, which is not necessarily optimal, but enjoys certain optimality properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MMSE DFBLE (i.e., MMSE DFE with a linear equalizer as its front-end) can be viewed as an MMSE LE followed by a decision feedback loop that can be implemented with a finite degree filter.
